comments.text: “Takt Op. Symphony,” a tactical strategy gacha-game with characters based on classical music, had a similar long goodbye, when it was announced it would have to shut down in three months due to new worldwide monetization policies. In the 9ish months it was running, it proved to have so much soul baked into the story and characters, and developed a cult following. When the sad news was announced, the developers offered super-boosts of resources and even new PCs in regular intervals, to allow those who stuck around a chance to experience the rest of the game with less grinding. Thanks to that, I managed to build a team with a variation (pun intended) that took me all the way through up until the last bonus boss I could not beat. Regardless of the circumstances, “Takt Op. Symphony” will hold a special place in my heart as one of my favorite gaming experiences.
